articles.title: Peter Thiel's Palantir Extends Partnership With Boeing Rival Airbus
articles.mainIdea: Peter Thiel's Palantir Extends Partnership With Boeing Rival Airbus
articles.summary: Benzinga: Peter Thiel's Palantir Extends Partnership With Boeing Rival Airbus. Software company Palantir Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ:PLTR), co-founded by Peter Thiel, has announced the expansion of its partnership with aircraft manufacturer Airbus SE (OTC:EADSY) (OTC:EADSF). Multi-Year Agreement In an official press release published on Tuesday, the companies announced the extension of their collaboration after signing a multi-year agreement on the open data platform Skywise, developed jointly by the two companies. articles.title: Boeing Job Shift Spurs Union Concerns And Raises Investor Execution Risks
articles.mainIdea: Boeing Job Shift Spurs Union Concerns And Raises Investor Execution Risks
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Boeing Job Shift Spurs Union Concerns And Raises Investor Execution Risks. Boeing (NYSE:BA) is shifting certain engineering jobs to its South Carolina operations, raising fresh union concerns. Union leaders report increased anxiety around potential layoffs and job security for engineering employees. The company has previously said there would be no immediate change in employment levels tied to the move.
